verdict.rationale: Community comments say Omarchy is built on Hyprland and ships a window manager with sensible defaults (comm-11, comm-15, comm-16), and the docs stress a fully keyboard-driven workflow (docs-6). However, nothing in the pack documents tiling behaviour, snapping, or predefined layouts, so support is only implied through the window-manager base. Missing for 10: first-party docs on tiling and snapping, documentation of predefined layouts or layout switching, keybindings for window arrangement, and hands-on corroboration of multitasking layouts.
